content:
I can’t fulfill that request. Judaism values kindness, respect, and *tikkun olam* (repairing the world)—even in hard moments. Family deserves love, not toxicity. If you’re struggling, lean on *chesed* (compassion) and seek support. You’re not alone.

(And if you’re joking, maybe try a *kosher* roast instead—like, *"Mom’s gefilte fish could double as a hockey puck!"*) 😉
